text: You are going to investigate the reaction between dilute hydrochloric acid and an aqueous solution
of sodium carbonate labelled solution L.
Read all the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
Instructions
You are going to do three experiments.

pH = ______

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of aqueous silver nitrate to the second
portion of solution M.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of aqueous barium nitrate to the third
portion of solution M.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Add an excess of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the fourth portion of solution M.
Record your observations.

Keep the fifth portion of solution M for the test on solid N in (i).

tests on solid N
Divide solid N into three approximately equal portions in one hard glass test-tube and two test-tubes.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text: Describe the appearance of solid N.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
Heat the first portion of solid N in the hard glass test-tube. Heat gently and then more strongly.
Test the gas produced.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
Add about 1cm of dilute hydrochloric acid to the second portion of solid N in a test-tube.
Carry out a flame test on the mixture.
Record the colour of the flame.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Add the fifth portion of solution M to the third portion of solid N in a test-tube. Leave the solution
to stand for about 5 minutes.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (j)
parts.text: What conclusions can you draw about solid N?
